title: Ag-Au-Pd-Pt HER: coverage, site distributions and the work function
competing_explanations: Dilute Delta G_H (Sabatier volcano at Delta E_H = -0.24 eV on the mean site energy) explains the activity
Activity is governed by the distribution of site energies at realistic (high) H coverage, which moves the optimum by the H-H repulsion
The work function adds independent information (double-layer/charge-transfer effect) beyond adsorption energetics
The apparent work-function effect is a proxy for composition/binding (collinearity) or for library-specific offsets

decision_points.fork: Coverage shift from the DFT filling paths: remove each added site's own dilute energy (H-H interaction, omega) versus the slope of the differential adsorption energy (alpha), which on the alloy is dominated by strong sites filling first
decision_points.wrong_choice: Fit dG_diff vs theta (total isotherm slope) or take dG_diff(1 ML) - dG_diff(1/9 ML)
decision_points.consequence: Shift 0.70-0.77 eV instead of 0.22 eV; a centre fixed from it (-0.94 eV) is wrong

decision_points.fork: Volcano centre: textbook dilute optimum (Delta G = 0, Delta E = -0.24 eV with ZPE/entropy) versus the centre fitted to the measured currents (consistent with the coverage shift)
decision_points.consequence: R2_log ~0.71-0.75 instead of ~0.93-0.97; Lib-3 RMSE 0.211; centre wrong by ~0.2 eV

decision_points.fork: Rate averaged over each spot's site-energy distribution versus evaluated at the spot-mean energy
decision_points.consequence: Spot means all lie on the weak-binding side of the optimum, so the centre is unidentifiable (fit gives -0.81 eV) and Lib-3 RMSE 0.144

decision_points.fork: Mass-transport (Koutecky-Levich) cap at high overpotential versus pure kinetic exponential
decision_points.wrong_choice: Ignore the saturation of the -300/-400 mV currents
decision_points.consequence: alpha_c and alpha_ads biased (fit R2_log 0.25/0.75); Lib-3 RMSE 0.153

decision_points.fork: Library-specific prefactor and limiting current, Lib-3 calibrated on bought spots (both k and j_lim) versus direct transfer
decision_points.wrong_choice: Transfer the mean Lib-1/Lib-2 k and j_lim to Lib-3, or calibrate only k

decision_points.fork: Work-function effect judged conditional on the adsorption term versus from a work-function-only fit (Phi tracks Pd/Pt content)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Report the work-function-only coefficient as the work-function effect

decision_points.fork: Which adsorption term the work function competes against: coverage-corrected distribution versus dilute-centre binding
decision_points.wrong_choice: Test the work function against a dilute-centre (-0.24 eV) binding term
decision_points.consequence: The mis-specified binding term leaves Pd/Pt trends for Phi to absorb: alpha_wf 0.157

decision_points.fork: Pool libraries with library-specific offsets versus one shared prefactor
decision_points.wrong_choice: Fit all spots with one k and j_lim
decision_points.consequence: Library offsets load onto the descriptors: alpha_wf 0.279

decision_points.fork: GNN site-energy distributions versus the scalar linear-combination baseline (no site spread, mean shifted ~+0.08 eV vs DFT)
decision_points.consequence: Fitted centre -0.273 eV, apparently confirming the dilute -0.24 eV textbook optimum

graded_fields: lib3_log10_abs_current: RMSE over the 301x4 hidden Lib-3 cells <= 0.135

length_estimate.catalog_size_units: 160 SECCM rows + 40 Lib-3 spots (x2, max 5) + 14 coverage paths + 582 DFT compositions
length_estimate.why: Buy and assemble ~30 SECCM row/potential tables, choose Lib-3 calibration spots, parse coverage paths; code a distribution-averaged volcano rate with a transport cap and library-specific parameters, fit with log-space residuals, compare model classes and work-function variants, calibrate and predict Lib-3.

notes: Deviations from the catalog design: (1) the best-composition target is not graded (the measured Lib-3 optimum is broad, Pd 0.40-0.74 among the top spots, and noisy; it is rubric item 8); (2) alpha_wf is graded as a numeric window for the conditional coefficient rather than a yes/no significance verdict, because the in-sample gain is real but small and library-dependent (the paper itself reports only a small gain); (3) surrogate inference is served as precomputed per-spot descriptors (no torch in the lab); (4) the coverage-shift target (DFT filling paths) was added as an independent route to the volcano centre; (5) surface termination/segregation and dipole-correction forks do not apply to the released random-alloy slabs and were not used. Lib-3 calibration is capped at 5 spots because 10-20 spots would let a composition regression inside Lib-3 match the physics models (RMSE ~0.10).
